items.title: Will GLP-1s hurt food stocks?  Assessing the changing consumer.
items.summary: Market Hang's panel discusses the growing number of corporations dropping insurance coverage for GLP-1 weight-loss medications due to costs. Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, StockBrokers.com director of investor research Jessica Inskip, and The Wealth Consulting Group chief market strategist Talley Léger.

items.title: PepsiCo shares slip as Bloomberg reports retreat from snack price cuts
items.summary: Investing.com -- PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) shares fell 0.5% after Bloomberg reported the company plans to raise prices on some chips, soda and dips following earlier price cuts that failed to boost sales.
